notes: Calendar: Wix Events on mtcsda.org (/calendar, /events). The widget shows upcoming events only (3 on Oct 1, 2026); past events were recovered from the event-pages sitemap (90 event pages) and each page's schema.org data. 56 of those pages are July 2025 camp-meeting classes (before the window).
Thin calendar: about 20 conference-level dated events in 18 months, mostly administration (5 board meetings, organizing and nominating committees, constituency).

2026 camp meeting was cancelled because of the Mount Ellis Academy gym renovation; replaced by a conference-wide weekend convocation (July 17–18) with the constituency meeting on July 19 at Bozeman High School. Camp meeting is back June 16–19, 2027 (outside the window).

Club ministries keep their own calendar at mtclubministries.org (upcoming only): leadership retreat Oct 16–18, 2026; PBE Feb 6, 2027; Pinewood Derby Feb 7, 2027 (also held Feb 1, 2026); club ministries fair Apr 29–May 2, 2027 and Adventurer family camp Aug 6–8, 2027 (outside window). A Virtual Pathfinder Club serves families far from local clubs.

Evangelism on the calendar: a church leadership workshop ("Breakout Churches", Oct 31–Nov 1, 2025) and an Amazing Facts discipleship workshop (Mar 6–8, 2026). Statements: "Each One Reach One" (a baptism in every church each year) and Renew & Restore — no dated events tied to them.
Quarterly Montana Herald newsletter and Gleaner Montana section carry local stories (Bozeman Hispanic group, remote ministry) but no extra conference events in the window.
